summary: The content is a .NET class for managing localization, specifically adapting user interface text based on language settings. It allows for translating labels and literals and adjusting date formats based on local preferences.
purpose: To provide localization support within an application by dynamically adjusting displayed content according to the user's language preferences.

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Array of UI controls to be localized.

fields.name: newValues
fields.description: Array of translated values corresponding to the fields array.

fields.name: UseAltLanguageFields
fields.description: Flag indicating whether to use alternative language fields.

fields.name: FileType
fields.description: The file type in the default language.

fields.name: FileTypeAlt
fields.description: The file type in the alternative language.

fields.name: LastLogin
fields.description: The last login date string to be localized.

actors.name: HSPnetSession
actors.role: Provides session-based information about language preferences.

workflows.name: Translate Fields
steps: Iterate over each field and corresponding new value.
If the field is a Literal, set its Text to the new value.
If the field is a Label, set its Text to the new value.

workflows.name: Translate File Type
steps: Check if UseAltLanguageFields is true in session.
Return FileTypeAlt if true, otherwise return FileType.

workflows.name: Translate Last Login
steps: Check if UseAltLanguageFields is true in session.
Replace English month abbreviations in LastLogin with localized equivalents.

conditions.action: Perform localization of fields or file types.

system_behavior: Adjusts UI elements based on session language preferences.
Supports dynamic localization with minimal changes to business logic.
